tools.name: list_rental_catalog
tools.description: List currently requestable machines from registered rental companies with equipmentId, specifications and delivery options. Paginate with the returned nextCursor.

tools.name: get_quote_requirements
tools.description: Check a partial or complete rental need. Returns missingFields / invalidFields / unsupportedFields with questions to ask the user. No commercial records, no notifications.

tools.name: search_rental_offers
tools.description: Calculate the real offer (rental, transport, insurance, VAT, Selbstbeteiligung) for a need. Contact data is not needed. No commercial records, no notifications. A ready result includes humanConfirmationUrl, a page where the user can confirm and request the PDF quote themselves.

tools.name: issue_rental_quote
tools.description: READ ONLY. Returns humanConfirmationUrl, the public quote page prefilled with the requested machine, dates, address and delivery when those fields are supported. Does not create a quote, booking or notification and sends no email. A person completes and confirms the quote on that page. Contact detai

tools.name: get_quote_document
tools.description: Read an issued quote's status and get a fresh short-lived PDF link (document.href, absolute URL). Needs quote.id and the accessToken from that issued quote. This tool does not create a quote.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote_requirements, search_rental_offers, issue_rental_quote, get_quote_document · Private data: get_quote_requirements, search_rental_offers, issue_rental_quote, get_quote_document · Public sink: issue_rental_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote_requirements, search_rental_offers, issue_rental_quote, get_quote_document · Private data: get_quote_requirements, search_rental_offers, issue_rental_quote, get_quote_document · Public sink: issue_rental_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
